title: Electronic System Components from Unlimited Technology Government
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > NAVSEA SHIPYARD > NORFOLK NAVAL SHIPYARD GF
description: Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY) in Portsmouth, Virginia, is seeking to purchase eight (8) separate items with different quantities.  This Request for Quote (RFQ N4215827QE011) is restricted to the items within being purchased exactly as stated from a single source vendor Unlimited Technology Government (CAGE 4ZXN5).  The specific items are listed in the attached RFQ under extended descriptions and in the document Attachment 1 Technical Capability Statement 27QE011.  Attachment 1 must have a check box marked next to each of the 8 items, and it must be signed and dated at the bottom.  This is your verification and guarantee that these exact items from Unlimited Technology Government will be procurred.  No substitions will be allowed.  The RFQ must be filled in, signed, dated, and returned to  Eliot Faircloth at  john.e.faircloth2.civ@us.navy.mil.  All offers must be comprehensive.  Other charges like shipping cannot be added later.  All offers must be submitted by November 30, 2026, at 11:00am Eastern Standard Time.
